pr_title: ADC: STM32: Add device tree config for clock and prescaler
pr_body:
This PR adds a ADC clock plus a prescaler to the ADC of the stm32 mcus.

With a `st,adc-prescaler` property in the ADC node, it is now possible to select the exact ADC clock scheme to be SYNC or ASYNC and its divider. By combining both information into one property, as follows : 
          `st,adc-prescaler = <ASYNC 16>;`
the clock prescaler is matching the LL_ADC_CLOCK_ASYNC_DIV16

Note that the **#include <zephyr/dt-bindings/adc/stm32_adc.h>** is required when setting the `st,adc-prescaler`.

It depends on the stm32 serie (refer to the RefMan) and if property is not set, a default config is applied by the LL_ADC_SetClock or LL_ADC_SetCommonClock at ADC driver init

It is increasing and replacing the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/44130


Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/40955


Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu [francois.ramu@st.com](mailto:francois.ramu@st.com)
pr_comments: next step: add a check on st,adc-prescaler len and 1st element to be SYNC or ASYNC if present

Add a commit (ceb218b5144fb80cf32c949404052615d59a0d9c)  to define a macro for check the correct format of the `st,adc-prescaler` property.
_COND_CODE_1 : To prevent the preprocessor from treating commas as argument separators, the_ _if_1_code _and_ _else_code _expressions must be inside brackets/parentheses: (). These are stripped away during macro expansion._
without checking the values of the divider in the `st,adc-prescaler` property

add the `#include <zephyr/dt-bindings/adc/stm32_adc.h>` to the dtsi for all the stm32 series
rename and reformat macro
remove 'prop' parameter from macro and access the `st_adc_prescaler` directly

Because the prescaler is now selectable (SYNC_x or ASYNC_x), some other conditions apply like for example on stm32WL : _"ADC common clock asynchronous prescaler is applied to each ADC instance if the corresponding ADC instance clock is set to clock source asynchronous."_

issue_context.title: ADC: STM32: Add device tree config for clock source
issue_context.body:
Looking here https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/drivers/adc/adc_stm32.c#L897, you can see that ADC clock source is hard-coded to `LL_ADC_CLOCK_ASYNC_DIV4`. I'd like to see some config added to the device tree to allow one to specify this.

I really need some help on what would be a good device tree addition to represent this.
comments:
I think that a new entry in the dts/bindings/adc/st,stm32-adc.yaml
```
    st,prescaler:
      type: int
      required: false
      description: |
        Clock prescaler at the input of the adc
        Could be in range [0 .. 0xF] for STM32 ADC prescaler
```

With a `clock_prescaler` field  in the `adc_stm32_cfg` structure directly defines the index of a `adc_clock_prescaler[]` table. So the stm32 adc driver init is passing this `adc_clock_prescaler[config->clock_prescaler]` instead of a fixed value,  as the CommonClock parameter of the `LL_ADC_SetCommonClock` function.

This `adc_clock_prescaler[]` table dimension depends on the STM32 serie, to fit the clock source (second) parameter LL_ADC_SetClock or LL_ADC_SetCommonClock.
@pdietl Do you plan to push a PR for this ?
Can anyone guide me on how to set the ADC Prescaler for STM32F105? The maximum value is 14MHz, but I cannot find any way to set this configuration on Zephyr. @FRASTM

for the stm32F105, The ADC prescaler is bit [15:14] of the RCC configuration register CFGR  (see [RM008](https://www.st.com/content/ccc/resource/technical/document/reference_manual/59/b9/ba/7f/11/af/43/d5/CD00171190.pdf/files/CD00171190.pdf/jcr:content/translations/en.CD00171190.pdf))
```
Clock configuration register (RCC_CFGR)

Bits 15:14 ADCPRE[1:0]: ADC prescaler
Set and cleared by software to select the frequency of the clock to the ADCs.
00: PCLK2 divided by 2
01: PCLK2 divided by 4
10: PCLK2 divided by 6
11: PCLK2 divided by 8
```

> Can anyone guide me on how to set the ADC Prescaler for STM32F105? The maximum value is 14MHz, but I cannot find any way to set this configuration on Zephyr. @FRASTM
